# glpi_entity (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI entity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_entity" "by_name" {
  name = "Root entity"
}

# The root entity has ID 0, which only the name lookup can address.
data "glpi_entity" "by_id" {
  id = "2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Name of the item. Set id or name; must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `completename` (String) Full path of the item in its tree, computed by GLPI.
